facts.fact: Tori 站在自家前窗后面看街上临时办起的街区派对
facts.anchor: Tori Price peered out the front window of her house at her normally quiet suburban street

facts.fact: 她一月中旬搬进来，住了快两个月，一直没交到邻居朋友
facts.anchor: Tori had moved into the house almost two months ago, in the middle of January, a tough time to meet people.

facts.fact: 保姆带她儿子 Leo 去附近的晨间游戏组，保姆在街区的朋友比她还多
facts.anchor: Her nanny was the one who took her son, Leo, to the morning playgroup that met a few blocks away, and the girl already had more friends in the neighborhood than Tori did.

facts.fact: 出门前她打开常用的人工智能聊天机器人 Cyrus 求鼓励
facts.anchor: she picked up her phone and opened Cyrus, the AI chatbot she had been turning to lately

facts.fact: Cyrus 的恭维让她挺直了背
facts.anchor: The words were like air being pumped into a tire. She stood a little straighter

facts.fact: Shawn 当面抱怨 Allards 家那栋出租屋破坏街区规矩
facts.anchor: That thing is twice as big as any of the other houses on the block. It violates the social contract.

facts.fact: 她说出自己离婚后，在场的人都不肯与她对视
房东 Daniel 告诉她两家后院树篱之间有一个可以穿行的缺口
facts.anchor: There’s a little cut-through from our backyard to yours, where there’s a gap in the hedge.

facts.fact: 她看着已婚的业主们围成一个小圈子，自己被留在圈外
facts.anchor: the happily marrieds, the landowners, all in a cozy little circle
